commons.title: Sayyid-Gräberfeld in Jelutong.jpg
commons.description: Sayyid burial ground on the graveyard of the Congregational Mosque (Masjid Jamek) of Jelutong, a suburb of George Town, Penang. The tombstone of Sayyid Shaykh al-Hadi (also written Syed Sheykh al-Hadi) is marked with a red arrow.
commons.editorial_reason: The Hadhrami source category specifically links the burial ground and tombstones to Hadhrami/Sayyid people, and the image visibly shows their graves and funerary architecture.
